A06_line_file_crosscheck.interpretation: closing_lines.csv and games.csv are NOT the same book or the same snapshot: spread agreement is partial and totals often differ by 0.5. Documented as an irregularity, not silently reconciled.

A07_sign_convention.note: A wrong sign convention would push the home cover rate far from 50%; 48.95% is the expected value for a valid market.

league_averages.benchmark_note: NFL league averages sit near 215-235 passing yards, 110-125 rushing yards, 20-22 receptions and 2.3-2.7 offensive TDs per team-game; a mapping error shifts these materially.

manual.detail: Commit a270278f3ac4e937295fe6a27814b3c4a2b62645, dated 2026-11-01T13:05:15Z, 'Automated data update'. Every CSV used downstream is fetched from that commit.

manual.claim: Player stat-id -> stat mapping (used to build the player-prop layer)
manual.detail: passing/completions 15:16, attempts 14:16+19, carries 10:11, rushing yards 10:13, receptions 21:22, targets 115, receiving yards 21:24, receiving TDs 22:24. Re-implemented in analysis/build_players.py and validated against league norms.

manual.claim: Player-stat layer produces NFL-normal league averages
manual.source_owner: internal validation against published NFL norms
manual.detail: 570 games, 11,202 player-game rows: 229.5 passing yards, 118.6 rushing yards, 21.0 receptions and 2.43 offensive TDs per team-game - all inside the published NFL ranges, which is the check that would fail first if the mapping were wrong.

manual.claim: Official ESPN game-page URL pattern used for the per-row source links
manual.detail: Every row of the game tables links to espn.com/nfl/game/_/gameId/<espn_id>. The pattern was confirmed from the event payload's own links array; the espn id is present for 7,548/7,548 rows of games.csv.

irregularities.item: Sportsbook identity for the closing lines is not documented upstream
irregularities.detail: games.csv ships spread/total/moneyline plus two-sided prices without naming the book or the snapshot time. All ROI figures in this project therefore describe 'the book in that file', not a specific sportsbook.
irregularities.mitigation: Every strategy is priced from the two-sided quotes actually stored, never from an assumed -110.

irregularities.item: Two upstream line files disagree with each other
irregularities.detail: closing_lines.csv (2006-2018) and games.csv agree on only 67.3% of home-team spreads, 61.7% of totals and 18.1% of home moneylines. They are therefore different books or different snapshots. No attempt was made to reconcile them; the models use games.csv.
irregularities.mitigation: Reported openly; the disagreement itself is a data-quality finding, not a bug.

irregularities.detail: No free source reachable from this environment publishes historical NFL player-prop lines/prices. The prop layer therefore reports correlations and calibration but cannot compute ROI; every prop EV number is a stated -110 scenario.
irregularities.mitigation: ROI gate blocked (not passed); correlations are verified from official play-by-play.

irregularities.item: Player data stops at the 2025 season
irregularities.detail: The nflverse/nflfastR-raw feed used for player stats was last updated 2026-02-09 (Super Bowl LX), so no 2026 player data exists. Player tables cover 2024-2025 only.
irregularities.mitigation: Page states coverage explicitly; 2026 player sections left blank.

irregularities.item: Venue naming differs between nfl.com and the dataset
irregularities.detail: nfl.com's Week 9 page lists Washington's venue as 'FedEx Field' while games.csv says 'Northwest Stadium' (the 2024 renamed sponsorship). Cosmetic, but rows are not edited to force agreement.
irregularities.mitigation: Flagged; the dataset value is shown and the official page is linked.

irregularities.item: Opening lines exist for one season only
irregularities.detail: initial_lines.csv contains 1,088 rows, all from the 2021 season. The line-movement strategy (S25) therefore fails the sample-size gate by construction.
irregularities.mitigation: Strategy kept and marked FAILED on the sample gate rather than deleted.

irregularities.item: 2026 Week 8 was only partially complete in the snapshot
irregularities.detail: The pinned commit contains one completed Week 8 game (CAR@GB) and posted lines for the remaining 13, which is consistent with the 2026-11-01 data timestamp but means any 'current form' figure for Week 9 excludes Week 8 results.
irregularities.mitigation: Stated on the Lines page; Week 9 model inputs are labelled as such.

coverage.note: Every published row links to an official page (ESPN game page, nfl.com schedule) or to the pinned upstream data file. Rows that could not be confirmed are left blank and listed on the Flagged for Review page.
